finalText:
**Fixed. All 625 tests pass.**

Only 3 cases were really failing, all in `orderTotal`. It took the discount off, but then charged tax on the full price. The comment above it already said tax goes on what the customer pays.

One line in `src/pricing.js` now taxes the discounted amount:

```js
const discounted = applyDiscount(cents, discountPct);
return applyTax(discounted, taxRate);
```

`verify.js` agrees. Nothing else changed.
